name: milo-functions
description: Milo v4 — Cloud Functions (2nd gen) backend. Firebase-native, RBI-compliant Razorpay Route flow.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth,database,storage
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.test: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,database "mocha 'lib/**/*.spec.js' --timeout 20000"
